ValidationRule.description: Requires Data Subject identity fields only during active processing stages.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "Data_Subject", OR( ISPICKVAL(Data_Subject_Lifecycle_Stage__c, "Upload"), ISPICKVAL(Data_Subject_Lifecycle_Stage__c, "Consent Request"), ISPICKVAL(Data_Subject_Lifecycle_Stage__c, "Active Consent"), ISPICKVAL(Data_Subject_Lifecycle_Stage__c, "Processing"), ISPICKVAL(Data_Subject_Lifecycle_Stage__c, "Report Request"), ISPICKVAL(Data_Subject_Lifecycle_Stage__c, "Report Fulfilment"), ISPICKVAL(Data_Subject_Lifecycle_Stage__c, "Departure") ), OR( ISBLANK(AccountId), ISBLANK(Full_Name__c), ISBLANK(Email), ISBLANK(TEXT(ID_Type__c)), ISBLANK(ID_Number__c), ISBLANK(Date_of_Birth__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Employment_Status__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Complete the required Data Subject identity fields before continuing this active processing stage.
